newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ITALIAN FIRST DIVISION WEEKEND FIXTURES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ITALIAN FIRST DIVISION WEEKEND FIXTURES.

text.p: Italian serie A games on Sunday (current standings in parentheses, kickoff times GMT):

Relegation battle in which Atalanta, with 12 points from their last six outings, should prove too strong. Filippo Inzaghi, joint leading goalscorer, heads Atalanta attack along with Gigi Lentini. Reggiana rely on experienced Romanian Ioan Sabau in midfield and Russian Igor Simutenkov in attack.

Injured Liberian striker George Weah and suspended French midfielder Marcel Desailly are both ruled out but Milan can compensate with the return of Paolo Maldini to a defence in which captain Franco Baresi makes his 700th appearance in competitive matches for the club. Relegation-battling Cagliari without Roberto Muzzi, Daniele Beretta and Uruguyan Luis Romero, all suspended.

Arguably the most attractive match of the day between two sides capable of attacking fireworks. Fiorentina's Argentine captain Gabriel Batistuta returns to partner Brazilian Oliveira in attack, while Sampdoria, without suspended French midfielder Christian Karembeu, field the prolific and in-form strike force of captain Roberto Mancini and Vincenzo Montella.

Another important step on the Inter path to possible title glory. English midfielder Paul Ince and defender Salvatore Fresi are both suspended but Inter field a new look midfield of Dutchman Aron Winter, Argentine Javier Zanetti, Frenchman Youri Djorkaeff and Swiss Ciriaco Sforza. Bologna welcome back Swedish striker Kennet Andersson alongside Russian Igor Kolyvanov.

After their six-goal midweek romp against French side Paris St-Germain, Juventus will fancy their chances against inconsistent Lazio. The league leaders will be without injured Croat striker Alen Boksic and suspended French midfielder Zinedine Zidane. Lazio at full strength with captain Giuseppe Signori, Pierluigi Casiraghi and Roberto Rambaudi in attack.

Winners against Milan, Juventus and Bologna in their last three outings, much-improved Parma should continue on their victorious way. Enrico Chiesa and Argentine Hernan Crespo return to join Croat Mario Stanic in the Parma attack, while all-Italian Verona rely on Pierluigi Orlandini and Filippo Maniero in attack.

Another dour relegation battle between two sides separated by only a point. Perugia, in their second game under former Parma coach Nevio Scala, may introduce midweek signing, goalkeeper Luca Bucci in place of Yugoslav Aleksandr Kocic. All-Italian Piacenza rely on Pasquale Luiso and Andrea Tentoni up front.

Despite winning 4-1 at home last week, Roma were jeered off the pitch by some of their fans. With Uruguyan striker Daniel Fonseca injured, Argentine Abel Balbo and Francesco Totti lead the attack against an Udinese side still missing injured German striker Oliver Bierhoff.

Uruguayan defender Gustavo Mendez returns for revelation side Vicenza who were probably unlucky in a 1-0 defeat by Milan last week. Napoli, defeated by Fiorentina and Inter on their last two outings, are led by Nicola Caccia and Alfredo Aglietti in attack with Brazilian Andre Cruz and Frenchman Alain Boghossian in midfield.
